observations: Photo 0: a used inline four cylinder petrol car engine, out of a car, sitting on the ground outdoors.
Photo 0: aluminium cylinder head with a silver valve cover, a black oil filler cap and spark plug leads, so it is a distributor and plug lead type engine.
Photo 0: a black ribbed timing belt cover, a crankshaft pulley and accessory brackets are on the front.
Photo 0: an intake manifold with throttle body and hoses runs along the top left.
Photo 0: some wiring harness and connectors are loose; surfaces carry dust and old oil grime.
Photo 0: no maker's logo, engine code stamp or label is readable; the only text is a seller watermark.
Photo 0: the photo is small and covers only the top and front; the block, sump, back and gearbox side are not shown.

identity.kind: used four cylinder petrol car engine, make and engine code unreadable

claims.evidence: No Toyota marking or engine code is readable in photo 0; the shape fits but does not prove it.
No engine code stamp is shown to confirm which engine it is.
Import origin cannot be shown by a photo of the engine.
No written guarantee terms are shown.

risks.risk: The engine may not be the Toyota Camry engine claimed, and the engine code sets the price.
risks.proof: A clear close photo of the engine code and serial number stamped on the block.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced as a Camry engine

risks.risk: Engine may not run, may knock, smoke, or have low compression or a blown head gasket.
risks.proof: A clip of the engine running on a test stand or in a car, from cold start, with sound and exhaust in view.
risks.if_unproven: as not running, for rebuild or parts

risks.risk: Block or head may be cracked, or the sump damaged, on sides not shown.
risks.proof: Photos of all four sides and the underside of the engine.

risks.risk: Parts may be missing, such as the alternator, starter, distributor or sensors.
risks.proof: Photos of each side showing which ancillaries are fitted.
risks.if_unproven: as a bare long block without ancillaries

risks.risk: The engine may be stolen or the serial altered.
risks.proof: A close photo of the stamped serial, checked for grinding or restamping, and a clearing or purchase document.
risks.if_unproven: held until the serial is checked

proof_requests: A clear close photo of the engine code and serial stamped on the block, with a handwritten note with today's date in shot.
A clip of the engine running from cold start.
Photos of all four sides and the underside.
The written terms of the guarantee.
response.reason: It is clearly a used four cylinder petrol car engine, but neither the make nor the engine code that sets its price is readable in photo 0, so no worst case price is possible until the block stamp is photographed.
